# Harbor Hall Event Spaces

Harbor Hall is a restored waterfront warehouse that now hosts conferences, product launches and company celebrations. Exposed brick, high ceilings and large windows overlooking the harbour give events a memorable atmosphere, while modern systems keep everything running smoothly behind the scenes.

## Main hall

The main hall is a single open floor that can be arranged in theatre, classroom or banquet layouts. Retractable dividers allow the room to be split into two or three smaller spaces for breakout sessions during the day.

FACT: Harbor Hall seats 400 guests in theatre layout.
FACT: Harbor Hall charges 12000 dollars per day for the main hall.
FACT: Harbor Hall includes in-house audio visual support at no extra cost.

## Catering

Our in-house kitchen prepares seasonal menus using local suppliers. Packages range from coffee and pastries to full plated dinners. Dietary requirements are handled by our chefs, and we can provide separate preparation areas for allergy-sensitive meals.

## Accessibility and transport

The building has step-free entry, a passenger lift to the mezzanine and accessible restrooms on both levels. Harbor Hall is a ten minute walk from the central train station, and a public car park is located across the street. Several hotels are within walking distance, and our events team can arrange group room blocks.

## Booking

Weekday bookings are available from eight in the morning until ten at night. A deposit of thirty percent confirms the date, with the balance due two weeks before the event. Cancellations made more than sixty days in advance receive a full refund of the deposit.

Our planners work with every client to produce a floor plan, run sheet and supplier schedule well before the event day.
